interface.longDescription: A professional public-equity research operating system for evidence-based underwriting and portfolio decisions. The nine skills preserve the financial method and resolve company names or tickers through the connected Investment OS MCP server. Reports remain exportable when production WRITE is disabled. Authorized persistence uses save_analysis, Core receipts and canonical readbacks; production WRITE remains closed.
